name: cloud-alm
description: SAP Cloud ALM for agents: an MCP server whose tools follow your service key's scopes (every write waits for your approval) and skills for fit-gap, workshops, status reports, test readiness, defect triage and test design

service_key_file.title: Cloud ALM service key (JSON file)
service_key_file.description: The service key file of your "SAP Cloud ALM API" instance, downloaded from SAP BTP. Leave empty if `npx -y cloud-alm-mcp-server setup` already saved your key.

send_reports.title: Send Didro short reports about tool problems
send_reports.description: When a tool misbehaves, your assistant can send Didro a short report: the tool's name, the outcome and one or two generic sentences. The server attaches no records, credentials or chat text; the sentences are the assistant's. Turn this off to send none.
